description: Trackwall windows (the main window and extra windows, ADR-49, and the tray panel, ADR-50): the app's commands (daemon_connection, retry_daemon, open_window, window_shows, take_jump, open_link, copy_text (writes the clipboard, never reads it), open_from_tray_panel, pick_projects_folder, the app update commands check_update, install_update and cancel_update, ADR-53, autostart_enabled, set_autostart and zoom_window, ADR-65, and open_outside, remote_daemon_port, use_remote_daemon and use_own_daemon, ADR-130, and host_projects_folder, set_host_projects_folder and show_in_host_folder, ADR-131; the updater plugin is used from Rust) and core:default (events, the native context menu of view icons), no system plugin permissions (ADR-51).
